author_framework: Micah Blumberg proposes a recurring pattern linking authority, its legitimating representations, allegiance and material access, within his existing contemporary reading of Revelation. The records distinguish that proposal from documented actions; no named actor is assigned a prophetic identity or political score.

timeline.title: Lieu and Moran announce the AI Kill Switch Act
timeline.record: The sponsor release describes a bipartisan introduced bill involving graduated interruption and shutdown of covered AI systems and lists supporting organizations.
timeline.limit: The linked full bill did not load; no enactment or verified implementation is claimed.

timeline.title: Sanders and Casar announce forthcoming prohibition and pause legislation
timeline.record: The official release describes a proposed superintelligence ban and a temporary advanced-development pause.
timeline.limit: This announcement precedes the public Coxon episode. Forthcoming legislation is not an enacted rule.

timeline.title: Coxon resignation publicity and the WSJ article
timeline.record: The article and following interview establish a public resignation-and-warning episode in this window.
timeline.limit: The exact first-publication minute and the supplied X timestamp remain unrecovered. A two-day window is not an authenticated ordering of article and post.

timeline.title: Coxon describes preparation and requested amplification
timeline.record: CNN's transcript records collaborative preparation of his thread and requests to friends for retweets.
timeline.limit: Self-reported promotion is not evidence that all later political events had the same organizer. The interview also presents his stated sincerity and a company response.

timeline.title: Trump emphasizes continued US AI leadership
timeline.record: Reuters reports his concern about losing the lead and his allowance for possible guardrails.
timeline.limit: The record neither endorses the position nor adopts his accusations concerning opponents.

timeline.title: Dumfries House AI summit
timeline.record: The Royal Household records the gathering and a speech calling for control, safety and cooperation, with a reference to a 2023 message.
timeline.limit: The event is not a law; attendance does not establish a shared undisclosed directive.

timeline.title: California issues Executive Order N-9-26
timeline.record: The order sets agency implementation dates and requests recommendations on several possible changes, including a verified kill switch.
timeline.limit: The requested recommendation is not an already enacted universal shutdown requirement.

timeline.title: Recommendations due under order paragraph 3
timeline.record: The signed order specifies this deadline for recommendations developed in consultation with experts.
timeline.limit: Future completion has not been assessed. This is not a date predicted by Revelation.

timeline.title: Independent-verifier criteria and procedures deadline
timeline.record: Paragraph 1 sets this date for the specified Government Code 8898.1 actions.
timeline.limit: The underlying statutory section was not separately audited here, and performance has not been assessed.

timeline.title: Specified Government Code 11549.82 actions
timeline.record: Paragraph 2 sets this date for completing subsection (a) requirements and beginning subsection (b) actions.
timeline.limit: This records the order's schedule, not a prediction that a particular later regime will exist.

comparisons.title: Person, kingdom and recurring pattern
comparisons.finding: Daniel's kings-and-kingdom language provides a textual basis for considering more than one level of representation.
comparisons.question: Which actions belong to an individual and which to the institution in the proposed comparison?
comparisons.limit: The word fractal is the author's analogy, not a measured pattern or a definitive account of John's exclusive purpose.

comparisons.title: Apollo is not named in Daniel 11:38
comparisons.finding: The god-of-fortresses passage does not identify Apollo; the reported residence artwork is a separate visual-source question.
comparisons.question: What object, catalogue or first-person explanation supports the claimed contemporary iconography?
comparisons.limit: Apollo, gold, Mammon and the first beast are not automatically interchangeable names.

comparisons.title: Gold appears in more than one moral setting
comparisons.finding: Gold occurs both in problematic luxury/image passages and in the renewed city's description.
comparisons.question: What act or relation, beyond material choice, is being interpreted?
comparisons.limit: Gold display alone does not demonstrate self-deification or cult worship.

comparisons.title: The second beast is not solely noncoercive speech
comparisons.finding: The image episode includes lethal consequences and the following verses restrict transactions.
comparisons.question: How are promotion, authorized speech and enforcement distinguished in each case?
comparisons.limit: Modern media are not assigned this identity merely because they influence audiences.

comparisons.title: A sign of belonging and an access condition
comparisons.finding: Deuteronomy's bodily sign and Revelation's forehead names support a comparison of rival allegiances.
comparisons.question: What actual rule connects a modern credential to an act of allegiance or a refused purchase?
comparisons.limit: An intertext is not an authenticated contemporary identification or the only possible background of the mark.

comparisons.title: A testing procedure is not a universal market permit
comparisons.finding: Pliny documents religious testing; Paul distinguishes market purchasing from ritual participation.
comparisons.question: Which city, date, institution and transaction imposed the claimed condition?
comparisons.limit: These sources do not establish one empire-wide worship certificate for every purchase.

comparisons.title: The Way of Death describes conduct
comparisons.finding: The Didache's catalogue includes deceit, greed and disregard for distressed people alongside other moral instructions.
comparisons.question: What sourced conduct, rather than a population label, is being compared?
comparisons.limit: No party, nationality or denomination is automatically assigned to a textual moral category.

comparisons.title: An alleged covert funding arrangement has specific records
comparisons.finding: DOJ's 2024 release describes charged conduct and expressly preserves the presumption of innocence.
comparisons.question: Which funding and editorial evidence supports the alleged connection, and what later disposition is documented?
comparisons.limit: The case is not proof of a separate AI-policy operation, and no current outcome is supplied here.

comparisons.title: Earlier policy announcements constrain the proposed sequence
comparisons.finding: The July 23 and September 3 announcements predate the September 8-9 publicity window.
comparisons.question: Is a claimed relationship prior planning, response, amplification or independent convergence?
comparisons.limit: Dates alone neither prove nor disprove every possible earlier contact.

comparisons.title: The WSJ-versus-X minute claim remains unverified
comparisons.finding: The retrieved article excerpt and inaccessible original post do not establish exact first-publication order.
comparisons.question: Can original timestamps, time zones and update histories be recovered from both publishers?
comparisons.limit: An advance article could have several explanations; none is selected as fact without further evidence.

comparisons.title: Preparation and requested retweets are publicly described
comparisons.finding: Coxon described collaborating on the thread and seeking retweets, while explaining his concerns as sincere.
comparisons.question: What additional documentary connection, if any, links this effort to a particular institution or later announcement?
comparisons.limit: Prepared advocacy is not by itself evidence of covert state control or knowingly false content.

comparisons.title: A ban, an emergency mechanism, a speech and a recommendations order differ
comparisons.finding: The cited documents have different actors, dates and operative forms.
comparisons.question: What exact enacted provision, coverage and observed implementation supports a claimed effect?
comparisons.limit: Neither universal centralization nor an exclusion outcome is established from the shared word safety. No policy recommendation or ranking is made.
